name: What should I measure and check before purchasing a walk-in tub?

mainEntity.name: What should I measure and check before purchasing a walk-in tub?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before booking an installation, measure all hallway turns, interior doorways, and stairwells from the entryway to the bathroom. Walk-in tubs are rigid, bulky units that cannot bend around tight corners, meaning standard 28-inch bathroom doors frequently require temporary widening or trim removal. You should also check the age and capacity of your water heater, as filling a 50-to-80-gallon walk-in tub often demands greater hot water volume. Sharing these details early helps HH Remodeling plan structural framing adjustments and mechanical checks before delivery.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure hallway and doorway widths leading to the bathroom to ensure entry clearance, and verify your water heater capacity to handle larger tub water volumes.
